newsitem.title: USA: INSIGHT-T-bond rally completes 50 pct retracement.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT-T-bond rally completes 50 pct retracement.

text.p: U.S. June Treasury bond futures posted steep gains this week and completed the 50 percent retracement of the February 18 to April 11 break.
Completing that retracement should stabilize the market in a range near term, analysts said.
June Treasury bond futures rallied to a two-month high early Friday to 110-10/32, fueled by initial reaction to a weaker than expected rise in April non-farm payrolls.
Jobs rose 142,000 against a downward revised 139,000 gain in March. Trade consensus had been for a 211,000 reading.
The jobless rate fell to 4.9 percent from 5.2 percent.
